source_boundary: Public information available through 2026-10-12. Overseas facts prioritize official investor-relations releases/prepared remarks. Domestic facts prioritize 2026 H1 listed-company filings and official disclosures. Secondary reports are used only to corroborate indexed filing details. Q3 2026 reports for the main A-share names were not yet a complete comparable set as of the source date.

research_sweeps.angle: Latest overseas cybersecurity earnings and AI-driven infrastructure/security demand
material_new_items: Fortinet 2Q26 revenue was $2.05B, +26% YoY; product revenue was $773M, +52%; billings +33%.
Fortinet management called AI a dominant driver of security-infrastructure modernization and disclosed an eight-figure neocloud AI-datacenter security win after a seven-figure Q1 win.
CrowdStrike FY27 Q2 revenue was $1.471B, +26%; net new ARR $333M, +51%; management called Q2 the best quarter in company history and said AI adoption needs security.
CrowdStrike said its AIDR business grew more than 79x in three quarters since launch.
Palo Alto Networks FY26 Q4 said recent AI advances are elevating cybersecurity to the top of CIO priorities.
research_sweeps.stop_reason: Primary IR converged on two simultaneous demand mechanisms: high-throughput network-security modernization and AI-native application/runtime/identity security.

research_sweeps.angle: 2026 H1 domestic filings for the user's original three names plus platform-security peers
material_new_items: 启明星辰: H1 revenue RMB1.235B +9.01%, net profit RMB30.8M vs loss; large-model application firewall revenue +238.15%, Agentic SOC revenue +31.99%.
绿盟科技: H1 revenue RMB812.6M +1.51%, net loss RMB129.0M with loss narrowing 24.77%; AI-security orders RMB117M; operator AI-security signings +300%+, while revenue conversion remained under pressure.

深信服: H1 revenue RMB3.998B +32.85%, net profit RMB231.2M vs loss; cloud+AI infrastructure revenue RMB2.212B +58.60%; network-security revenue RMB1.587B +10.57%; firewall processing performance +50%-100%; no separate AI-security revenue disclosure.
安恒信息: H1 pure-AI revenue >RMB41M and indirect AI-enabled-product revenue >RMB64M; total revenue RMB739.1M +0.86%, loss narrowed.
奇安信: H1 revenue RMB1.497B -14.09%, loss narrowed; broad product AI-ization continued but no quantified AI-security monetization was found in the checked H1 disclosure.
亚信安全: network-security segment revenue RMB540M +6%; AI-agent identity/AIXDR products advanced, but no isolated quantified AI-security sales were found.
research_sweeps.stop_reason: This sweep proved domestic monetization is real but heterogeneous: reported AI-security revenue, AI-security orders, broader AI infrastructure, and product/technology progress are different evidence grades.

research_sweeps.angle: Audit-triggered peer recall across domestic firewall, ASIC security and large-model security vendors
material_new_items: 天融信: H1 AI-security-protection revenue grew more than 130% YoY and AI-enabled-security direct revenue exceeded RMB80M, while total H1 revenue fell 33.99%; this is both monetization evidence and a counterexample to the idea that AI immediately rescues the whole legacy security base.

山石网科: H1 revenue RMB451.3M +8.28%; ASIC security products achieved scale commercialization, with Q2 ASIC-security product revenue accounting for about 20%; 2G-200G firewall range provides a direct domestic high-performance-firewall modernization datapoint.

迪普科技: H1 disclosures show TB-class processing and high-performance data-center/AI-compute network scenarios, but no isolated AI-security monetization was found; classify SECONDARY rather than silently omit.
research_sweeps.stop_reason: The audit-triggered sweep closed the obvious material peer gaps. Additional names no longer changed the three core economic classes or the central monetization ladder, so the universe remains explicitly bounded rather than claimed exhaustive.

market_explanation_scope_reason: The article asks whether AI is creating incremental cybersecurity demand and how that demand is appearing in vendor results. It does not require an explanation of why one A-share stock led, hit a limit, or outperformed another. Company comparison therefore remains operating/earnings evidence, not price-formation analysis.

what_changed: AI security moved from a threat narrative into measurable vendor demand: Fortinet shows unusually fast product growth and AI-datacenter wins; CrowdStrike shows accelerating ARR and a rapidly scaling AI-security category.

The network layer is changing because AI clusters create more east-west, encrypted and machine-generated traffic, raising throughput, segmentation and visibility requirements beyond a routine perimeter-firewall refresh.
The application/runtime layer is changing because models and agents introduce prompt-injection, sensitive-data leakage, identity/privilege and agent-runtime risks before and after release.
Domestic 2026 H1 reports now contain concrete AI-security revenue or orders, but evidence quality differs sharply across companies.
transmission_chain: AI compute and data-center expansion → more east-west/encrypted/machine traffic and higher-value model/data assets
Traffic/segmentation requirements exceed legacy firewall architecture → high-performance firewall/ASIC/SASE modernization and new deployment
Models and agents enter production → model gateway, application firewall, identity, endpoint/runtime, data and governance controls become incremental security surfaces
Customers shift security involvement earlier into AI development/deployment and consolidate tooling where platforms can cover more surfaces
Commercialization appears first as product revenue/ARR/orders; domestic accounting recognition then separates vendors by realization speed
counterevidence: Traditional Chinese cybersecurity budgets remain uneven: 奇安信 H1 revenue fell 14.09%, and 天融信 total H1 revenue fell 33.99% despite fast AI-security growth.
绿盟's RMB117M AI-security orders are not equivalent to recognized revenue; its report explicitly notes conversion pressure.
深信服's +58.60% cloud+AI-infrastructure growth cannot be relabeled as AI-security revenue; its separately disclosed network-security revenue grew 10.57%.

Fortinet product acceleration cannot be attributed entirely to AI because broader refresh, vendor consolidation and firewall cycles coexist; management only indicates AI is a larger-than-normal driver.

Cloud/frontier-model providers can embed native security capabilities and compete with third-party vendors, so incremental AI-security spend is not automatically captured by incumbent standalone vendors.
uncertainties: 启明星辰 did not separately disclose the absolute revenue base of its large-model application firewall in the checked material; +238.15% is a growth rate, not proof of large absolute scale.
绿盟's order-to-revenue conversion timing and margin profile remain key unresolved operating variables.
山石网科's ASIC commercialization reflects AI/data-center performance demand but also domestic chip/localization and product-refresh effects; these drivers should not be collapsed.
The domestic universe is bounded to economically material platform/firewall/AI-security vendors with 2026 H1 evidence; it is not a claim to list every small cybersecurity stock.
